name: Gimai Hole to Imouto Hold
original_name: 義妹ホールと妹ホールド
source:
A new sister joins the family, a twintailed brat.
The other little sister comes home to meet her sadist oniichan.
Sleeping just beneath his bedroom in the house.
Chiho and Mayo. Who will you choose? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE100868.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个新的妹妹加入了家庭，是个扎着双马尾的小鬼。

另一个妹妹回到家中，迎接她的虐待狂哥哥。她就睡在哥哥卧室的正下方。

千穗与真夜，你会选择谁？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE100868.html]DLsite English[/url]]
